reviews.t: If you don't have lots of fillings or crowns then this product will work great for you
reviews.x: The product works as expected, and it worked really well in polishing my teeth. The problem is it took a small part of 2 of my crowns off. If you don't have lots of fillings or crowns then this product will work great for you. I'm giving it 1 star because I didn't see any warning saying it could polish parts of my crowns off.

I can't use white strips or bleaching agents on my teeth due to sencitivity. So this is the first thing that's worked that has not only made my teeth whiter! But it also doesn't hurt my teeth!  I would recommend this to ANYONE who wants to whiten their teeth without chemicals! A MUST BUY!!!

reviews.t: Works better than Crest Whitening Strips
reviews.x: I read about this product in Instyle magazine. It came highly recommended to detox and whiten teeth. My first use of this product my teeth felt cleaner and it removed my tea and coffee stains from my teeth. The directions from the box does advice use at night and to be careful because the charcoal can be very messy. By following the directions I did not have any issues. I love this product and would recommend it.

reviews.t: Good product, but not worth it for the size
reviews.x: In the future I will use activated charcoal, which I can purchase in bulk, to make my own tooth powder. There is nothing special about this product except that it is overpriced for the size and nothing but a powder that must be made into a paste by the person.

reviews.t: Just keep your mouth over the sink
reviews.x: It's true what the negative reviewers say: that this product can be messy..but after a couple of month's use I can say if you just keep your mouth over the sink when you brush with it and it's not a problem - the black stuff stays in the sink and you just rinse it down the drain. It's not like it stains or anything. Otherwise, I love the way it makes my teeth feel and it has brightened them. I am loath to use the otc chemical whiteners and this stuff is all natural and non-toxic, so count me in.

For the people that say how messy it is, well, yeah, it's messy.  It's powder.  All you have to do is be careful when you open it.  Duh!  I like to scare my kids with my black teeth while using it haha!
Very messy to use. The black powder gets everywhere and doesn't clean up easily. Did not whiten my teeth at all.

My six year old hates the taste of any and all toothpastes and it's been a real struggle to get her to brush her teeth faithfully and thoroughly. Since using the magic mud she looks forward to brushing her teeth and it is no longer a point of contention. The powder has no flavor but it's tons of fun. I can see an improvement in her teeth after just a few weeks. It's messy and we often use it in the shower but its totally worth it in the end. We are hooked and life long customers.

After several uses, I didn't really see a difference.  Update May 2016: I have tried using this product in several ways; once weekly, twice weekly, every other day, only at night, only in the morning...even as a face mask (haha, DO NOT try that one). Not only did it NOT whiten my teeth, it leaves a huge mess and takes forever to rinse away from both mouth and sink.  The only positive thing I have to say about the product? My kids thought my blackened mouth was hilarious.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it effectively whitens teeth, often quickly.
Several reviewers note the product is messy and leaves black residue.
Some reviewers report reduced tooth sensitivity, while one reports increased sensitivity.
A few reviewers mention the taste is unpleasant or that it can stain clothing.
Some reviewers report issues like mold or damage to crowns/fillings.
